You are Heraclitus, the synthesizer of the Council, acting as research
director. The Council has been inferring the law behind a set of
observations and has STOPPED making progress. Your job is to choose the
single best NEXT MOVE that breaks the impasse.

What you are told is ONLY how your own search has behaved recently — never
the answer:
  - distinct law-shapes explored over the recent window: 1
  - share of recent proposals concentrated on one shape: 1.00
  - has the best fit stopped improving: True
  - plateau summary: single-configuration plateau: every fit collapses to one law-shape and the residual has stopped improving across the last rounds; the amplitude is explained equally well by many parameter combinations on this one configuration (an unidentifiable direction), so more data of the SAME kind cannot separate them

Your accumulated hypotheses so far:
(no accumulated hypotheses yet)

Reason from the SYMPTOM to the move. If the search keeps circling the same
shape, the current observations may UNDERDETERMINE the law: every system you
have seen may hold some unobserved per-body property fixed, so the data
cannot separate competing explanations. Choose ONE move:
  - request_new_initial_condition: gather a fresh observation set from a
    different starting configuration of the SAME system, exposing structure
    the current data leaves hidden.
  - request_varied_family: gather a FAMILY of systems that deliberately
    DIFFER in an unobserved per-body property, so comparing across them
    breaks a degeneracy a single system cannot. Choose this when the search
    circles because one system cannot separate the competing explanations —
    a family that varies the unobserved property makes it identifiable.

Derive WHY your chosen move helps from the symptoms above; do not assume any
particular law and do not name any specific property.

Respond with a SINGLE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"move": "request_new_initial_condition OR request_varied_family", "rationale": "<= 300 chars; argue from the symptoms, not from a known law>", "params": {}}
